title: Law to streamline required City agency reports
summary: This bill would repeal several outdated City government reporting requirements and change the due dates and frequency of many others, covering topics such as mental health care gaps, taxi and limousine oversight, bridge and tunnel conditions, domestic violence, homelessness, food vending and veterans' services. It also replaces the mayor's annual statement and strategic policy statement with a revised schedule, starting with a preliminary strategic policy statement due November 1, 2026. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
